evals.name: release-dev-to-prod
evals.prompt: We've merged a good chunk of work into dev over the last couple of weeks — the new settings page, a CSV export feature, and some bug fixes. main is on 1.2.0 right now. I want to ship all of it to production. Walk me through exactly how you'd cut and ship this release, with the specific branches, commands, and version.
assertions: Creates a release/* branch off dev, not directly merging dev into main
Bumps the minor version to 1.3.0 (new features present), not a patch or major bump
Specifies a merge commit (--no-ff) into main, not a squash merge
Includes tagging main with an annotated v1.3.0 tag on the merge commit
Mentions updating CHANGELOG.md as part of the release and opening a break-glass revert PR after merging to main

evals.name: hotfix-prod
evals.prompt: Users are seeing the wrong label on the account card in production right now — it's a tiny one-line fix. This can't wait for the next release; I need it live today. What's the exact process to get just this one fix out to production?
assertions: Branches hotfix/* off main, not off dev
Bumps the patch version (e.g. 1.2.0 to 1.2.1), not minor or major
Specifies a merge commit (--no-ff) into main and back-merging the hotfix into dev as well
Requires CI to be fully green before merging to main, no bypassing checks or hooks
Includes tagging the release and opening a break-glass revert PR left open after merging to main

evals.name: feature-branch
evals.prompt: I'm about to start building a bulk user-import feature — probably a few days of work. Where should I branch from, how should I name it, and how does it eventually make its way into production?
assertions: Branches feat/* off dev, not off main
PR for the feature merges into dev via squash merge, not a merge commit or direct merge to main
Clarifies that the feature only reaches production later via a release branch, not immediately
Does not touch CHANGELOG.md per-feature (that happens at release time)
Follows Conventional Commits for the branch's commit messages / PR title
